[{"node":"loopar_desk_pages_menu_content","element":"menu_content","data":{"key":"loopar_desk_pages_menu_content","id":"loopar_desk_pages_menu_content","name":"loopar_desk_pages_menu_content"},"elements":[{"node":"desk-pages-overview","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Overview","key":"desk-pages-overview","id":"desk-pages-overview","name":"desk-pages-overview","value":"# Desk Pages & Dashboards

The Desk sidebar is organized by **app**: a rail of app icons on the left and the selected app's modules next to it. Two tools let you give each app a useful landing place without code:

| Tool | What it is | Where it lives |
|------|------------|----------------|
| **Desk Page** | A page designed by drag and drop — shortcuts, figures, recent records, charts | Files of the app (`modules/<module>/desk-pages/<page>/`), shipped with it |
| **Dashboard** | A board of charts and figures | A record — editable by users in production |

Everything on them is filtered by the viewer's permissions: a shortcut to an entity the user can't open disappears, and figures only count what the user may list (an `own` scope narrows them to the user's records).
"}},{"node":"desk-pages-builder","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Desk Pages","key":"desk-pages-builder","id":"desk-pages-builder","name":"desk-pages-builder","value":"## Desk Pages

Create one with **Desk Page Builder** → **New**:

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Name** | Page name |
| **Module** | Module (and therefore app) it belongs to |
| **Icon** | Shown in the sidebar and the command palette |
| **App home** | Open this page when the app is picked in the rail (one home per app) |

Then design it in the **Desk Page Designer**. Besides the usual layout and content elements, its palette offers the **desk** elements:

| Element | Shows | Properties |
|---------|-------|------------|
| `shortcut` | A big link to an entity, page or URL, optionally with a live counter | `target`, `action` (list / create / view), `url`, `icon`, `description`, `featured`, `show_count` |
| `number_card` | One figure of an entity | `entity`, `aggregate` (count / sum / avg / min / max), `field`, `format` (number / currency), `prefix`, `suffix`, `icon`, `description`, `url` |
| `quick_list` | The latest records of an entity | `entity`, `fields`, `limit`, `view_all_label`, `empty_message` |
| `module_cards` | A card per module of the app the user can reach | `app` |
| `chart` | A Dashboard Chart | `chart`, `chart_type` (bar / line / area / donut — empty uses the chart's own), `height`, `format`, `description` |
| `dashboard` | A whole Dashboard record, embedded | `dashboard`, `show_description` |

### Filters

`number_card` and dashboard items take a **filter**: a JSON object of `field: value` equalities. Two tokens are available:

```json
{ "status": "Open", "assigned_to": "@me", "due_date": "@today" }
```

`@me` is the current user, `@today` today's date. Unknown fields are ignored.

A typical app home: a row of `shortcut`s to the daily screens, a row of `number_card`s (open orders, today's sales), a `quick_list` of the latest records and a `chart` of the month.
"}},{"node":"desk-pages-dashboards","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Dashboards","key":"desk-pages-dashboards","id":"desk-pages-dashboards","name":"desk-pages-dashboards","value":"## Dashboards

### Dashboard Charts

A **Dashboard Chart** is a reusable query over an entity:

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Entity** | The entity to read |
| **Chart type** | Bar, line, area or donut |
| **Value** | Count, sum or average (of **Value field**) |
| **Group by** | *Over time* (by a date field, per day / week / month / year, over the last 7 / 30 / 90 / 365 days or all time) or *By field* (the top N values of a field) |
| **Field** | The date field or the grouping field |
| **Filter** | JSON equalities, as above |

Use a chart in any Desk Page (`chart` element) or in a Dashboard.

### Dashboard records

A **Dashboard** is a record anyone with permission can build and change in production:

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Name** / **Description** | |
| **App** | The app it belongs to |
| **Show in sidebar** | List it in the app's sidebar |
| **Items** | Charts and numbers, each with a width (¼, ⅓, ½, ⅔ or full) |

An item is either a **Chart** (pick a Dashboard Chart) or a **Number** (entity + count / sum / avg / min / max + optional field, format, prefix and filter).

Opening a dashboard shows the board; **Edit** opens its form. Every item is computed with the viewer's permissions, so the same dashboard shows each user what they are allowed to see.
"}},{"node":"desk-pages-navigation","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Navigation","key":"desk-pages-navigation","id":"desk-pages-navigation","name":"desk-pages-navigation","value":"## Finding Your Way

### Command palette

Press **Ctrl + K** (**⌘ + K** on macOS) anywhere in the Desk to jump to:

- an entity's **list** or a **new** record form
- settings (single entities), pages, modules, app homes and dashboards
- a **record**, by typing part of its name or title
- **Find "…" in a list** — opens the list already filtered

Recent destinations are remembered on your browser.

### Shareable lists

A list's filters, search and page live in its URL — `/desk/Customer/list?status=Active&page=2` — so you can bookmark it, reload it or send it to a colleague and they see the same list.
"}}]}]
